property_summary: For any caller (admin) and any address, whenever setOwner(a) completes without reverting, its boolean return value must truthfully report the ownership effect, i.e. equal (c.owner() == a) after the call; the reference returns true matching the applied change, while the mutant returns the never-assigned success flag (false), which contradicts the fact that owner was actually changed to a.
change_summary: Return the success variable (never assigned, so false) instead of the literal true.
